lead: A focused history station: about 5 minutes with a simulated patient, then the examiner asks your diagnosis and plan. Use the full frame and go deep only where her complaint points.
f: The frame
Personal data · presenting complaint · history of the pregnancy · past obstetric · gynaecological · medical and surgical · drugs, allergy · family · social
Dates and parity

LMP, cycle, pill or lactation · EDD by Naegele: + 7 days − 3 months + 1 year (cycle 35 d: add 7 days) · dating scan (CRL 8–13 wk) beats LMP · Gravida = all pregnancies · para = births ≥ 24 wk · twins count as one birth · grand multipara ≥ 5
Past obstetric history
Mode of each birth · previous CS: indication and type (VBAC or repeat) · PPH: active 3rd stage and IV line · macrosomia, stillbirth: screen for diabetes · pre-eclampsia, preterm birth
Risk factors and systemic review
Age < 18 or > 35 · consanguinity · occupation · past disease · always a short systemic review
Hypertension and pre-eclampsia
Headache, visual disturbance, epigastric pain, swelling · high BP at 10 wk = chronic hypertension

sc: Headache, flashing lights, BP 150/100 at 34 wk → Severe pre-eclampsia

f: Bleeding in early pregnancy
Amount, clots, tissue passed, pain, fainting · shoulder-tip pain = blood in the abdomen · vesicles + severe vomiting = mole

sc: Shoulder-tip pain and fainting at 7 wk → Ruptured ectopic

f: Antepartum haemorrhage
Painless bright red (praevia) vs pain, hard uterus, dark blood (abruption) · bleeding at ROM with fetal bradycardia = vasa praevia · no digital VE until the placenta is located

sc: Painless bleeding with a previous CS → Placenta praevia

f: Anaemia, diabetes, fever and malaria
Anaemia: diet, pica, short spacing, worms, stopped iron · diabetes: past GDM, macrosomia, family history · fever with rigors, no bed net, no IPTp → malaria · haematuria, canal water → schistosomiasis
Reduced movements and leaking liquor
Fewer movements: when, how long, risk factors → CTG and scan · leaking: gush or continuous, colour, smell, fever · wet on coughing without pooling = stress incontinence
Presenting the history
A long history in 2–3 min: summary, positives, relevant negatives, impression, plan
